value.rationale: Cyclic rotation is a natural unknown-origin ambiguity in subsequence-based reconstruction and fixed composition is the canonical constant-weight sampling model. This theorem exactly quantifies distinguishable start positions at every (n,k), proves gcd-one perfect distinguishability and characterizes every worst case, and reveals a sharp square-root collision deficit for fixed gcd despite n possible rotations. It is an infinite-family structural probability law, not just a renaming or a short computational table. The limitation to a binary two-subsequence observation model and fixed gcd asymptotics is explicit.
